title: Learning structural balance of graphs from quantum spectral features
abstract: arXiv:2609.11736v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a quantum approach to spectral feature extraction from the density of states (DOS) of a problem-dependent Hamiltonian, and apply it to machine learning on signed graphs. We propose to embed a signed graph as an Ising model instance with positive and negative interactions, and use the standardized moments of the Ising DOS as features for learning. We show that these moments count signed closed walks, are switching-invariant, and are size-free by construction. As a benchmark, we target learning the frustration index, an NP-hard measure of structural balance that can be labeled exactly at moderate size. At zero field, the models can be sampled classically, allowing the quantum extraction procedure to be certified against exact ground truth. translated_title: 从量子谱特征学习图的结构平衡
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种从与问题相关的哈密顿量的态密度（DOS）中提取谱特征的量子方法，并将其应用于符号图上的机器学习。我们提出将符号图嵌入为具有正负相互作用的Ising模型实例，并使用Ising态密度的标准化矩作为学习特征。我们证明这些矩对应于符号闭合路径的计数，具有规范变换不变性，并且在构造上与图的规模无关。作为基准任务，我们针对学习挫折指数（frustration index）——这是一种NP难的结构平衡度量，在中等规模下可以获得精确标签。在零场条件下，这些模型可以进行经典采样，从而能够将量子提取过程与精确的真实值进行对照验证。我们提出了DOS-QPE，一种在纯化的最大混合态探针上进行的相位估计方法，其采样谱密度所需的测量次数比基于Hadamard测试的迹采样方法少几个数量级。
tldr: 本文提出了一种量子谱特征提取方法，将符号图嵌入为Ising模型并利用其态密度的标准化矩作为学习特征，成功学习NP难的结构平衡度量（挫折指数），且所提出的DOS-QPE方法所需测量次数比基于Hadamard测试的迹采样方法少几个数量级。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantum spectral feature extraction method that embeds signed graphs as Ising models and uses standardized moments of their density of states to learn the NP-hard frustration index, with the proposed DOS-QPE requiring orders of magnitude fewer shots than Hadamard test-based trace sampling.
